multiverse.name: Zentry Gaming Multiverse
multiverse.description: Zentry is the world's largest shared adventure and a unified Play Economy. It unites players from countless games and platforms—both digital and physical—into a single massive multiplayer real-life RPG (MMORPG).
multiverse.motto: The Game of Games begins—your life, now an epic MMORPG.
multiverse.core_mechanic: Every game you play, step you take, and action you perform adds to your real-life XP, ranks, and earnings in the shared play economy.

the_pillar.name: The Boundless Pillar
the_pillar.description: The cosmic center where infinite realms converge. It is the anchor of Zentry's multiverse, holding secrets of ancient games and portals to future dimensions.

quests.title: Explorer
quests.tips: Click the Vault option in the menu or navigation to enter the Vault and complete this quest.

quests.title: Stalker
quests.tips: Head to your profile/dashboard to sync your statistics and complete the quest.

quests.title: Reader
quests.tips: Read the latest entries in the news section to stay updated on multiverse changes.

features.name: Celestial Visuals
features.description: Immersive video layers and deep parallax stars that create a cosmic, multiverse atmosphere.

features.name: GSAP Transitions
features.description: Smooth transitions and micro-interactions powered by Greensock (GSAP).

features.name: Premium Auth UI
features.description: A state-of-the-art login/registration gateway that deploys your identity in the Multiverse.

features.name: Interactive Multiverse Map
features.description: An interactive map showcasing the layers and convergent paths of the game economy.
